notes: The 🔬 now catches the sneakiest data problem of all: missing days. A thin share's quiet days can skip bulk downloads entirely, so this device's copy can be identical on every day both sides hold — and still be missing the most recent days the server has (one share tonight had stopped 6 days short while still trading). The check now counts those missing days, says so plainly, and the 🩹 Repair button can now fix this kind too — it re-pulls the complete series for exactly those shares.
